author: JostingMosting
quote:
Pros: 
High quality, Great visuals

Cons:
Story: 
Assumes people are about characters instantly. Starts off Slow with fetch quests. Very limited freedom in the first chapter. Story has some ups and a lot of downs. Jason is not very well written and is bland. Lucia is put in an instant spotlight that wasnt earned. Most cut scenes are quite bland compared to GTA5. Somewhat corny dialog. 

Technical stuff: 
Targeting 30FPS. 30FPS are only possible if you stand still or do the least physics heavy stuff. If you forget to do the first save, the game doesn't auto-save. Different levels of polish depending on which version (PS5 or XBOX).

Gameplay: 
House chore simulator. (Hours of my life i cant get back)
Unable to draw weapon within your own neighborhood. 
Cant steal cars from your neighborhood. 
Cant commit Grand Theft Auto unless you got an APP. (Even when carjacking people)
Morality meter. 
Cant replay missions.
Some NPCs are unable to be shot
General bugs (Collision, shots not connecting, the car randomly getting thrown or crushed).
Very limiting in Freedom.
Missing collision from planes and buildings. 

This game is almost false advertisement with the tile. 0/10 wouldnt recommend.
